_comment: accounts: the show's official X handles without the @ (survivorcbs not yet re-confirmed). weak: keywords that are also everyday words or names shared with someone famous; they only count with a context word, a second keyword, or on an air night. context: show vocabulary that backs up a weak keyword but never covers on its own. aliases: show names and hashtags that never change. people: names that matter every season (the host). seasons: one per season; castaways (full names and the names they go by) in people, tribe names, twists and season hashtags in terms. episodes: CBS Wednesday 8 PM ET air dates, oldest first; the finale gets "kind": "event".
